expected_response.note: No registered bounded declarative edit is connected to the Analyst's leading coordinate hypothesis by the executing pointcloud scalar; incumbent retained.

failure_modes: A registered pointcloud_delta_A or region_index edit would change the endpoint pointcloud curvature or regional attention without any executing term for the pair-kernel or joint-internal contrasts the Analyst reports, so the predicted response is null or off-target rather than the hypothesized short-shell shift.

A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit would condition on time-varying contrasts that curve_support marks legendre_runtime_allowed false and that show sign changes and strong sign conflicts, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates.
Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity would misattribute last-record credit to final affinity benefit.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest signed contrasts (short pair-kernel shells 1.5/2.5 A, endpoint_effects:9-10; branch_adjusted:86-87,163-164,240-241) are diagnostic descriptors of the endpoint pointcloud, and the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). The permitted edits act only through pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend, none of which can express a pair-kernel or joint-internal contrast, so no registered bounded edit is connected to the Analyst's leading hypothesis by the executing formula. The joint-motion evidence (branch_adjusted:74,76,151,153,228,230,305,307; joint_diagnostics:1,2,11,14) is likewise supplied as adjusted/joint diagnostics, not a reward term. The temporal alternatives are unsupported: continuous trends show sign changes and strong sign conflicts, and curve_support reports legendre_runtime_allowed false for every audited feature, so a time-conditioned teacher blend or temporal region index is not justified. Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support), so it cannot license a coordinate edit. Global centroid and most shape components do not survive multiplicity adjustment, and the information audit's excess-distance metric is nonnegative by construction and not a causal affinity effect. With no defensible expected advantage from a registered bounded edit, retaining the incumbent is the correct affinity-first choice; temperatures remain fixed and no resampling, affinity-head derivative, extra forward or graph-equality restriction is introduced.
